what_it_does: ChatEED is an AI-powered assistant system designed for staff at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory who operate particle accelerators. It helps them search and interpret years of accumulated operational log entries (called ELOGs) that are messy, incomplete, and filled with jargon. The system automatically summarizes shift handovers and retrieves relevant historical information in real time to answer operator questions. It was designed by directly interviewing the facility's operators to understand what information they actually need during their daily work.
